headlines.description: Andrew Luck and the Indianapolis Colts had a great first quarter and did just enough the rest of the way to hold on for a 33-28 victory over the Houston Texans on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts start fast, hold on against Watt, Texans

events.name: New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw four touchdown passes and posted his 60th career 300-yard game to lead the New England Patriots to a 37-22 win over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady (4 TDs), Patriots pull away from Bills

headlines.description: Mike Nugent missed a 36-yard field goal attempt on the final play of overtime Sunday, which left the Cincinnati Bengals and Carolina Panthers in a 37-37 tie -- the NFL's first this season.
Brian Hoyer passed for 217 yards and pulled off a rarity for a Cleveland quarterback, leading the Browns to a 31-10 rout over Ben Roethlisberger and the rival Pittsburgh Steelers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns, Hoyer cruise to rout of rival Steelers

headlines.description: Titans snap skid, beat winless Jaguars 16-14
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans snap skid, beat winless Jaguars 16-14

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw a 4-yard touchdown pass to Andrew Quarless with 3 seconds left Sunday, and the Green Bay Packers rallied past the Miami Dolphins 27-24.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers completes Packers' rally on late TD

headlines.description: Tahir Whitehead intercepted Teddy Bridgewater twice, Joique Bell put the game away with a fourth-quarter touchdown run, and the Detroit Lions beat the Minnesota Vikings 17-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions pick off Bridgewater 3 times in victory

events.name: Denver Broncos at New York Jets

headlines.description: Peyton Manning threw three touchdown passes, leaving him two shy of Brett Favre's career mark, and the Denver Broncos beat the New York Jets 31-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning's 3 TDs help Broncos hold off Jets

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Flacco throws 5 TDs, Ravens rout Buccaneers
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco throws 5 TDs, Ravens rout Buccaneers

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Jay Cutler threw for 381 yards and a touchdown, Matt Forte ran for a couple of second-half scores, and the Bears picked up another road victory by beating the Falcons 27-13.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears dispatch Falcons behind Cutler, Forte

headlines.description: Palmer returns, leads Arizona to win over Redskins
headlines.shortLinkText: Palmer returns, leads Arizona to win over Redskins

headlines.description: DeMarco Murray became the second running back in NFL history with six straight 100-yard games to start a season, and the Dallas Cowboys stunned the Seattle Seahawks 30-23 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray, streaking Cowboys rush past Hawks

events.name: New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: Nick Foles threw two touchdown passes, LeSean McCoy had a season-high 149 yards rushing and the Philadelphia Eagles beat the New York Giants 27-0 on Sunday for their first shutout in 18 years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles stomp Giants for 1st shutout in 18 yrs

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Colin Kaepernick threw for 343 yards and three touchdowns, helping the San Francisco 49ers erase an early 14-point deficit and beat the St. Louis Rams 31-17 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaepernick, 49ers roar back, finish off Rams
